firm_data.firm_description: Dewey Pegno & Kramarsky LLP is a litigation boutique that specializes in complex commercial and securities matters, as well as internal and government investigations. The firm has an established record of successfully representing businesses and individuals in complex civil litigation and arbitration.
notable_facts: Founded in 1998 by lawyers from Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP and Kaye Scholer LLP.
Recommended as a leading law firm for New York General Commercial Litigation by Chambers & Partners.
Recognized by Best Lawyers and U.S. News & World Report’s Best Law Firms in New York City Litigation - Securities, Tier 3.
Named twice by The National Law Journal to its Litigation Boutiques Hot List.

email.subject: AI for Dewey Pegno & Kramarsky LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi David,

Your boutique's track record in complex commercial litigation and securities matters speaks volumes, especially given the caliber of talent you've attracted since 1998. That kind of specialized practice demands precision tools that understand nuance over volume.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to explore fit. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping litigation boutiques like yours compete with larger firms.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
